talento.description: No estás mandando tu CV a un buzón que nadie abre. Dejas tu perfil una vez y las empresas que de verdad están contratando llegan a ti — con fecha, y con un proceso que termina en una respuesta.

engineers.title: Tired of recruiters ghosting you? Let them come to you
engineers.description: You are not sending a CV into a mailbox nobody opens. You leave your profile once and the companies that are actually hiring come to you — with a date, and with a process that ends in an answer.

empresas.title: Deja de quemar semanas en entrevistas que no filtran nada
empresas.description: Contratar un dev se te va en cuadrar calendarios, leer CVs que no dicen nada y justificar decisiones de memoria. Esa parte te la quitamos: entrevistas con fecha y feedback por escrito.
empresas.imageAlt: Taco Tuesday. Interviews with a date, feedback in writing, and nobody left on read.

companies.title: Stop burning weeks on interviews that filter nothing
companies.description: Hiring an engineer goes into juggling calendars, reading CVs that say nothing and defending decisions from memory. We take that part off you: interviews with a date and feedback in writing.
